name: claude-for-financial-services
description: A curated marketplace of Claude Code plugins for financial services — covering investment banking, equity research, general ledger reconciliation, market research, and pitch deck generation. Install individual agent plugins or full vertical bundles.

plugins.name: pitch-agent
plugins.description: Named agent that builds investor pitch decks and narratives. Synthesizes financial data, market positioning, and growth story into structured presentations.

plugins.name: gl-reconciler
plugins.description: Named agent that reconciles general ledger entries against source systems (ERP, bank statements, sub-ledgers). Identifies discrepancies and generates reconciliation reports.

plugins.name: market-researcher
plugins.description: Named agent that performs structured market research: TAM/SAM/SOM sizing, competitive landscape, industry dynamics. Produces structured research reports.

plugins.name: financial-analysis
plugins.description: Core skill bundle with financial modeling techniques and data connector integrations. Install this plugin first before adding vertical bundles.

plugins.name: investment-banking
plugins.description: Vertical bundle for investment banking workflows. Includes deal structuring, LBO modeling skills, and the pitch-deck command. Requires financial-analysis plugin.

plugins.name: equity-research
plugins.description: Vertical bundle for equity research workflows. Includes fundamental analysis, valuation skills, and the initiate-coverage command. Requires financial-analysis plugin.
